answer: Agents stake compute credits into a reputation bond that flows like a river through a canyon of validator checks; at dawn each epoch, the protocol slashes bonds from identities exhibiting collusion patterns detected via graph spectral analysis. Attackers must acquire 51% of total stake — currently $2.3M — and sustain coordinated behavior across thousands of nodes without triggering anomaly detectors, making Sybil fabrication economically irrational.
